ladder.label: COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE
ladder.why: Short-term, a daily bottoming setup is forming — but the bigger picture is bearish (weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)). A bounce here is COUNTER-TREND: daily-cycle lows that don't line up with a weekly-cycle low tend to be left-translated and fail, then cascade toward the larger cycle low — exactly the trap of buying a daily low in a falling investor cycle. The daily cycle has already failed (broke its own start low). Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 70.8. Not an investment buy; wait for the weekly timeframe to actually turn up (or a fresh investor-cycle low to confirm) before trusting it.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 62 · failed · daily cycle broke its start low 32d ago).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): counter-trend bounce. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.

entry.text: Counter-trend bounce inside a bearish bigger picture. For nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 70.8. If the daily low fails it cascades toward the larger cycle low; not an investment buy.
entry.text_zh: 处于看空大局中的逆势反弹。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、将止损紧贴 70.8 下方。若日线低点失守，将向更大周期低点蔓延；并非投资性买入。

cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 62 of a typical 16–26 weeks

ladder.why_zh: 短期来看，正在形成日线筑底形态——但大局看空（weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)）。此处的反弹属于逆势：与周线周期低点不对齐的日线周期低点往往呈左移结构并最终失败，随后向更大周期低点蔓延——这正是在下行的投资者周期中买入日线低点的陷阱。日线周期已经失败（跌破其自身的起始低点）。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
